name: Explore both project case studies
description: Read both real projects and return to their compact cards.

Close it, open the MechanicSolution case study, and inspect both live project link destinations.
expected: Each project reveals its own detailed case study and collapses correctly; links point to drinkstore-ng-zww9ys.v2.appdeploy.ai and autocare-pro-zz4flw.v2.appdeploy.ai.

name: Read qualifications on mobile
description: Navigate and read verified professional information on a phone.
steps: Use Skills and About navigation links.
Use Experience and scroll through education and certifications.
expected: Sections are readable without horizontal scrolling, education includes B.Sc. Economics Education and certifications, and Back to top returns to the introduction.

name: Access application documents and contact
description: Check document actions and contact destinations.
steps: Click Download CV. If the resource has been uploaded verify a PDF downloads; otherwise verify the visible message offers niyiola48@gmail.com.
Navigate to Contact and inspect the email and GitHub links.
Click Print / save portfolio as PDF; cancel the browser dialog if one opens.
expected: CV action gives either a PDF or an explicit unavailable message, contact links target niyiola48@gmail.com and github.com/mendix200, and print action is available.
